symptom: A Starlark rule could not read a domain model annotation: not in strings(), modules(), entities() or documentable_elements(), and annotations() was undefined. A 'no TODO notes' rule covered microflows (annotations are activities) and passed every domain model.
cause: No catalog table held DomainModel.Annotations, though the decoded domain model already carries them (list annotations reads them).
insight: A domain model annotation's Caption is a plain string, not a Texts$Text, so the translatable-strings walk never reaches it and adding it to strings() would have been the wrong home. Own the rows by the domain model unit (b.own(dm.ID)), like the entities, so TestCatalog_RowsBelongToADocument and the incremental tests need no allowlist. CATALOG.ANNOTATIONS hit the keyword trap (LIST ANNOTATIONS) and TestEveryCatalogTableParses caught it before any manual run. A microflow annotation is activity_type == 'Annotation', not action_type: check a field name against starlark.go before documenting it. Cross-check counts per module with LIST ANNOTATIONS.
